canonical_project: Oman Data Park / Otech Duqm data centre (SEZAD)
notes: ODP Duqm data centre opened Feb 2018 (Tier 3, DCPost MEA); located SEZAD HQ building, Duqm, Al Wusta (Central); one of ODP's three linked Level 3 centres (Duqm, Wattayah, Muscat); hosts Port of Duqm Company DR infrastructure. A-grade operator/ODP listing; capacity not disclosed.
